APPLICATION / HEAT TRANSFER

How quickly does a hot sample cool?

Explore the interaction between internal diffusion and heat exchange at the walls. Robin boundary data make the boundary part of the physical model.

Dimensionless example: initial temperature 1, ambient 0.2, diffusivity 0.1, boundary exchange 2. At t = 3, the computed mean is 0.74486.

Measure, then compare

Define a final mean, a local probe or a threshold event. Check whether the thermal-content change matches the recorded boundary and bulk input.

The initial boundary mismatch represents sudden cooling. Material-specific prediction requires physical parameters and experimental validation.

18 October 2026 pre-event snapshot. The article describes completed work and does not claim a new mathematical theorem. Event-period additions must be recorded separately.

Choose the right numerical problem.

One to three fields; 1D/2D periodic models; supported second-order bounded problems with Dirichlet, Neumann or passive Robin conditions; 1D fourth-order problems with two configurable linear boundary rows at each end.

Computation uses local browser workers. No account or runtime LLM API key is needed. General geometries, arbitrary PDEs and 2D nonperiodic fourth-order problems are outside this release.
